image_title: Cost of the Most Disabling Injuries 1998-2008
summary: The line chart titled 'Cost of the Most Disabling Injuries 1998-2008' illustrates the financial impact of disabling injuries over a decade, measured in billions of dollars. The chart shows a general upward trend from $37.1 billion in 1998 to $53.4 billion in 2008, with a peak at $51.7 billion in 2001. After a slight decline to $48.6 billion in 2004, the costs rise again, reaching $53.0 billion in 2007. The data source is the Liberty Mutual Research Institute, 2010, highlighting the economic burden of injuries over time.
